slides.title: 3 Habits That Get You Hired Faster
slides.subtitle: Most cyber candidates skip all three

bullets: Build a home lab - document every project you run
Write about what you learn - even short LinkedIn posts
Reach out to 3 people in cyber every single week

caption: Stop waiting to feel ready. These three habits separate the people who get hired from the ones still preparing. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #jobsearch #cypherjobs #infosec
